statement: Carpet costs $\$28$ per square yard, installed. A rectangular room measures $15$ feet by $12$ feet. What is the cost to carpet the entire floor of the room? ($1$ yard $= 3$ feet)

choices.misconception: I multiplied the area in square feet, 180, by the price per square yard without converting units.
I divided the 180 square feet by 3 to get square yards, but one square yard is $3 \cdot 3 = 9$ square feet.
I changed the sides to 5 yards and 4 yards but found the perimeter, 18 yards, instead of the area.

hints: The price is per square yard, but the room is measured in feet.
Convert each side to yards first, or find the area in square feet and divide by the number of square feet in one square yard.
The room is $5$ yards by $4$ yards, so its area is $20$ square yards.

solutions.reliable: Convert the sides: $15$ ft $= 5$ yd and $12$ ft $= 4$ yd. The area is $5 \cdot 4 = 20$ square yards, and the cost is $20 \cdot 28 = \$560$. Check another way: $15 \cdot 12 = 180$ square feet, and $180 \div 9 = 20$ square yards. The idea: an area conversion uses the square of the length conversion factor.

author: Devansh Sanghavi
